title.description: Draft title, mirrored from document.title so drafts can be listed without unwrapping the document.

document.description: A pub.leaflet.document-shaped draft. Its pages use pub.leaflet.pages.linearDocument and pub.leaflet.blocks.* blocks so the draft can be published as a Leaflet document.

publishedUri.description: AT URI of the pub.leaflet.document record created when this draft was last published.

postUri.description: AT URI of the site.standard.document record created when this draft was last published.

main.description: A working draft of a post, stored as a Leaflet document.
